notes: A new UPC whose metadata lookup returns no title now remains available as a pending UPC instead of clearing the Library results.
Existing media is shown immediately when the UPC title is unknown, including manifest entries whose UPC value is null.
Library Lookup now opens with every known title in one A–Z list below the search bar, with a properly constrained touch-scrollable results area.
Typing in the same search box filters the existing collection by title while retaining the pending UPC.
Selecting a result attaches the pending UPC to that title in one click.
